The NHL statistics API returns 10 games played and 36 goals for Carolina. All three are NHL.com properties. The build uses the standings table, which is timestamped and internally consistent.

flagged.item: NHL.com standings and the NHL stats API report different goals for and against for the same clubs.
flagged.detail: The standings table counts the shootout-deciding goal; the stats API's goalsFor/goalsAgainst does not. Seventeen of the 32 clubs differ in this snapshot, and every difference equals that club's count of shootout wins (goals for) or shootout losses (goals against). Ottawa read 24 GF on nhl.com/standings against 22 in the API over the same nine games, with two shootout wins; Seattle 39 v 37 with two shootout wins; Buffalo 27/34 v 27/33 with one shootout loss; Detroit 23/28 v 22/26 with one shootout win and two shootout losses; Dallas 23/15 v 22/14 with one of each. The 16 clubs without a shootout are identical in both feeds. The desk's model uses the standings view, so clubs with shootout games carry a slightly higher scoring rate than the API implies - at most 2 goals over 9-11 games, about 0.2 per game. Both figures are official; the gap is definitional and no number was adjusted. Independently re-derived from the official feeds on 2026-10-21 by session db99ed90, which captured the same 14 NHL fixtures separately.
